conventions.rule: A post-close live-state transition is valid only if it replays exactly from the checkpoint after-image through the same builders the writer uses; lifecycle records are evidence, never authority.

Any data recorded at sprint close must enter the checkpoint's frozen close inputs (and be derived from them), never be added to the ledger or post-close state directly; otherwise checkpoint re-derivation and retries break.
Any git-based check of the working tree must exclude Kyro-managed paths: the workspace .agents/kyro/ and every root path starting with .kyro-state-writer.lock (including .reclaim-* leftovers).
Read-only git status calls must pass --no-optional-locks so they never rewrite .git/index.
